componentMappings.title: Postgres adapter public boundary
componentMappings.rationale: Exports transactional state, plan, archive, delivery and capability adapters behind stable PostgreSQL boundaries.

componentMappings.title: Run state persistence
componentMappings.rationale: Persists run events, snapshots and metadata without owning lifecycle rules.

componentMappings.title: RunStateCommandPort bridge
componentMappings.rationale: Explicit bridge from the DVT run-state command boundary into PostgreSQL write storage.

componentMappings.title: Postgres plan store
componentMappings.rationale: Stores and queries immutable/admitted plan records and executable plan artifacts.

componentMappings.title: Outbox + lineage persistence
componentMappings.rationale: PostgreSQL implementations for delivery/outbox facts and lineage outbox storage.

componentMappings.title: Run archive persistence
componentMappings.rationale: Persistence adapters used by state-store archive/retention lifecycle.

componentMappings.title: Backpressure snapshot reader
componentMappings.rationale: Reads bounded delivery-pressure snapshots used by admission policies.

componentMappings.title: Object-file to Postgres capability
componentMappings.rationale: Provider-specific object-file materialization capability exposed to runtime plugins.

componentMappings.title: Schema + runtime composition
componentMappings.rationale: Owns PostgreSQL schema migration/runtime configuration mechanics, not domain semantics.

componentMappings.title: Credentials + pool policy
componentMappings.rationale: Infrastructure-level credential binding and observed pool failure policy.
